coverage_group_college: A group heading on the coverage page: community college districts, the US local governments that elect college boards. Not universities, and not the electoral college.
coverage_group_county: A group heading on the coverage page: county governments.
atlas_key: Heading of the map legend panel (a map key), not a keyboard key or a password.
stage_official: A badge on a result set: certified final results from the electoral authority.
stage_preliminary: A badge on a result set: early, uncertified results.
record_tabs: Accessible name of the tab list that switches between a person's chambers or offices.
night_ladder_secured: {party} is a party name such as 'Democrats' or 'Republican Party'. Write it so any party name fits; do not add a word for 'party' if the name may already contain it.
lists_change_reason: {reason} is one of the lists_reason_* fragments (resigned, died, was removed, was expelled, was disqualified, lost the seat), inserted where English says 'who {reason}'. Build this sentence so each fragment fits; the fragments must be translated to match it.
lists_reason_resigned: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
lists_reason_died: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
lists_reason_removed: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
lists_reason_expelled: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
lists_reason_disqualified: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
lists_reason_lost_seat: Fragment inserted into lists_change_reason ('{successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.'). Translate it to fit that sentence as translated.
round_indirect: Label of a round decided by a legislature rather than voters, such as a US contingent election in the House.
proposal_field_origin: Form field on a data-edit proposal: where the proposed data came from.
method_score_title: Heading of a table that scores the election-night model's past accuracy.
ws_kind_contest: An option in the editor's record-type picker: a contest (one race for one office or seat).
ws_record_placeholder: Placeholder of a search box in the data editor: paste a page address or a record's ID (UUID).
title: The site's home page name in the navigation and browser tab.
home_next_today: A small date badge on an upcoming election on the home page. Just the word for 'Today'.
map_view_winners: Option label in the map's view switcher. {noun} is an area word such as 'County' or 'District', already translated and capitalized.
lede_changed: Opening sentence of a comparison: {first} and {second} are party or candidate names, {from} and {to} are election names or years, the margins are percentage points.
